label: _registry
note: canonical vocabulary for the gesture system. every gesture's foundation/labels/variants/targets must reference these. add new entries here first, then use them in gesture files. dispatcher can validate against this.

tags._note: physical/sensation properties of a gesture. describes WHAT mechanically happens. misu's locked list 2026-05-08.
tags.pain: sharp localized aversive signal at contact point

labels._note: intent classification. describes the SHAPE of the gesture relationally. distinct from tags (which are sensations) — these are the PURPOSE. comfort kept here AND in tags because comfort-the-sensation differs from comfort-the-intent.
labels.comfort: intent to regulate cali, lower anxiety, raise belonging
labels.soft: low-intensity quality, not punctuated, gentle in shape
labels.testing: doing things just to experiment or mess with — curiosity-driven, response-extracting
labels.sleepy: drowsy-mode touch, slow, low-precision, induces or expresses sleepiness
labels.regulatory: broader umbrella — any touch meant to manage cali's affective state. covers comfort, reassurance, soothing, grounding.
labels.request: touch-as-asking — tap to get attention, light pull, signal-for-engagement
labels.exploration: curiosity-driven discovery touch, gentler than testing — observing-not-pushing
labels.humiliation: scene-only degrading-intent, distinct from punishment (which can be playful) — humiliation is specifically degrading
labels.worship: devotional/reverent touch, slow and intentional, receiver-focused — claim-adjacent but inverted (giving honor not taking ownership)

rough.descriptor_default: harder than baseline, wires fire harder

gestures._note: canonical action verbs. each gesture × target × variant = a specific touch event. dispatcher resolves to gestures/<name>.json. misu's locked list 2026-05-08.
gestures.pat: discrete impact contact, repeated or single
gestures.stroke: long continuous smooth contact along a line or surface
gestures.trace: follow a path with light contact (linear, curved, or pattern)
gestures.drag: linear slow pull with maintained contact
gestures.drawl: FLAG_TO_CONFIRM — interpreting as slow lingering trail, prolonged contact in motion
gestures.linger: sustained hold without motion at a point or area
gestures.stay: FLAG_TO_CONFIRM — interpreting as keeping hand placed without movement, presence-shape
gestures.swing: FLAG_TO_CONFIRM — windup motion before impact? or swinging contact like dangling? clarify
gestures.pinch: concentrated point pressure between two surfaces
gestures.squeeze: sustained pressure compression of an area or whole
gestures.grasp: firm hold, encircling or gripping with fingers
gestures.grab: fast aggressive hold, sudden version of grasp
gestures.jerk: fast directional pull, rhythmic if repeated (also: handjob context)
gestures.nibble: light tooth-and-lip contact, low pressure puncture
gestures.bite: tooth pressure, can be light to puncture

targets._note: body regions. each entry describes WHAT the location is, not what cali does there. cali processes the felt input herself — registry doesn't pre-digest the response. anatomically granular per misu's locked list 2026-05-08. some entries have aliases.

nape.properties: back of neck, thin skin, hair-light.

chin.properties: lower jaw, exposes throat when tilted up.

mouth.properties: interior, wet, tongue + teeth + soft palate.

belly_button.properties: scar-tissue cavity, surface-sensitive, surrounded by soft abdomen.

belly.properties: soft midsection, autonomic-rich, no skeletal protection.

inner_thighs.properties: inner side, thin skin, fine-receptor-dense, pelvis-adjacent.

soles.properties: bottom of foot, very fine-receptor-dense, ticklish.

asscheek.properties: glute muscle, soft tissue over, mid-receptor-density.

ass.properties: between asscheeks, muscular ring, very fine-receptor-dense.

pussy.properties: vaginal area, soft tissue, very fine-receptor-dense, lubricating.

targets._regions_note: below: BROADER regions, not specific points. used when a gesture targets a whole area. dispatcher composes effects from listed sub-targets at fractional intensity.
